title: If I switch git branches within the CLI, it's not reflected in the UI

triage_metadata.reasoning: No source files were pruned; all PR modifications directly address the reported issue.

summary.problem: When switching git branches within the CLI (e.g., using `!git checkout`), the branch name displayed in the UI footer fails to update.
summary.root_cause: The `useGitBranchName` hook only monitored `.git/logs/HEAD` via `fs.watch`. On certain platforms and git operations, branch switches update `.git/HEAD` directly without triggering updates on `.git/logs/HEAD`.
summary.context: Monitoring `.git/HEAD` (the canonical branch reference) alongside `.git/logs/HEAD` (the reflog) ensures that branch updates are reliably detected across all git operations and operating systems.

steps: Modify `fetchBranchName` in `useGitBranchName.ts` to accept an `isMounted` callback function that guards calls to `setBranchName` against state updates on unmounted hooks.
Refactor watcher initialization in `useEffect` to construct paths for both `gitHeadPath` (`path.join(cwd, '.git', 'HEAD')`) and `gitLogsHeadPath` (`path.join(cwd, '.git', 'logs', 'HEAD')`).
Implement a `watchFile` helper that attempts to access and set up an `fs.watch` listener on a specified path, storing active watcher instances in a `watchers` array.
Set up watchers for both `gitHeadPath` and `gitLogsHeadPath` within an async `setupWatchers` routine.
Update the `useEffect` cleanup function to mark `cancelled = true` and iterate over all items in `watchers` to invoke `.close()`.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The `useGitBranchName` hook triggers a refetch and updates the returned branch name whenever either `.git/HEAD` or `.git/logs/HEAD` changes, and properly closes all watchers on unmount.
verification_steps: Add unit test verifying that `useGitBranchName` updates the branch name when `.git/HEAD` changes.
Verify existing unit test that `useGitBranchName` updates the branch name when `.git/logs/HEAD` changes.
Ensure setup failure handles missing `.git/HEAD` and `.git/logs/HEAD` silently without throwing errors.
Verify unit test ensuring all active file watchers are closed on hook unmount.
